name: Energy & Utilities
description: Generation, grid, smart meters, trading, and outage management
rules: Meter reads are immutable after settlement; corrections are adjustment records
Outage and restoration events must sequence correctly for SLA reporting
Market bid/offer data follows market operator cut-off windows
Critical infrastructure telemetry access is least-privilege and audited
memories: DST transitions break naive interval arithmetic — always use TZ-aware intervals
AMI late reads common; settlement uses estimate-then-true-up pattern
